title: Succession and Shifting Identities in Freshwater, Built Environment Biofilm Communities
description: The composition of biofilms in the raceways of a hatchery of a trout farm were determined throughout a production cycle to gain insights into the temporal dynamics. The microbiome was characterized by sequencing 16S rRNA V4 amplicons.
